meta.title: DawaCheck — check your medicine
meta.description: Find a cheaper Jan Aushadhi generic, check batch safety alerts and fair prices, using public government data.

home.tagline: Check your medicine in seconds: cheaper generic, safety alerts, fair price.
home.scanBody: Take photos of the front and back
home.privacy: Your photos and location stay on your phone.
home.kendraBody: See the 3 nearest Kendras, with directions

common.disclaimer: DawaCheck gives information from public government data. It is not medical advice. Always consult your doctor or pharmacist before changing any medicine.

search.notConfirmed: Couldn't match confidently — please check with your pharmacist.

kendras.title: Nearest Jan Aushadhi Kendra
kendras.intro: Find the 3 Jan Aushadhi Kendras closest to you.
kendras.pinUnknown: We don't know this PIN code yet. Try a nearby PIN code, or use your location.
kendras.pinApprox: Using the approximate centre of your PIN code area.
kendras.locationDenied: Location was not shared. You can type your PIN code instead.
kendras.privacy: Your location stays on your phone. Distances are worked out on your phone, not on our server.
kendras.noneNearby: No Jan Aushadhi Kendra within 10 km. These are the closest:
kendras.noneAtAll: We couldn't find any Kendra near this place.
kendras.stockNote: Stock is not published, so please call before you go.
kendras.mapNote: The map comes from OpenStreetMap, which will see the map area (not your exact location).
kendras.straightLine: Distances are in a straight line; the road may be longer.
kendras.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

scan.title: Scan your medicine strip
scan.stepFront: Step 1 of 3: front of the strip
scan.stepBack: Step 2 of 3: back of the strip
scan.frontHint: Photograph the side with the medicine name.
scan.backHint: Photograph the side with the batch number, expiry date and MRP.
scan.tip1: Lay the strip flat, in good light.
scan.tip2: Tilt it slightly so the foil doesn't shine.
scan.tip3: Fill the photo with the strip and keep the text sharp.
scan.loadingModel: Getting the reader ready (first time only)…
scan.privacyPhoto: Photos are read on your phone and never uploaded.
scan.confirmIntro: Fix anything that is wrong. Fields marked "Please check" were hard to read.
scan.ingredientsHint: One per line, for example: Telmisartan 40 mg
scan.notRead: Not found. Type it if you can see it on the strip.
scan.error: Couldn't read this photo. Try again in better light, or type the name instead.
scan.demoNote: Demo: uses sample photos made for testing, not a real medicine.
scan.stepStamp: Step 3 of 3 (optional): close-up of the stamp
scan.stampHint: Move close so the printed batch number, dates and MRP fill the photo. It is fine if the text is sideways. This helps a lot on shiny foil.
scan.matchError: Couldn't match right now. Please check your internet and try again.
scan.discontinuedNote: Our 2022 data lists this brand as no longer sold. The comparison is still for the ingredients on your strip.
scan.abstainNoBrand: Type the medicine name in the box above, then try again.
scan.abstainNoCandidates: Couldn't find this name in our medicine list. Check the spelling, or ask your pharmacist.
scan.abstainContradiction: Couldn't match confidently — the closest medicine we know has a different strength, form or ingredient than your strip. Please check with your pharmacist.
scan.abstainStrength: This medicine comes in more than one strength. Which one is on your strip?
scan.abstainUnsure: Couldn't match confidently — please check with your pharmacist.
scan.pickFromThese: If your strip is one of these, choose it:
scan.evidenceNote: We compare what was read from your strip with our medicine list. We only show a medicine on our own when nothing disagrees and we are sure enough; otherwise we ask you.

checks.title: Checks for this strip
checks.error: Couldn't run the checks right now. Please check your internet and try again.
checks.genericFound: Jan Aushadhi sells the same medicine. Price and savings are below.
checks.genericNone: No Jan Aushadhi medicine has exactly the same ingredients, strength and form.
checks.batchAlert: This batch was reported in a government quality alert. The finding applies to the tested batch. Show this to your pharmacist.
checks.batchSpurious: This batch was reported as spurious (fake) in a government alert. Show this to your pharmacist.
checks.batchNotFound: Batch {batch} is not in the government quality alerts we checked.
checks.batchOnly: Batch {batch} is in an alert, but for a different medicine, so not this one.
checks.batchNoBatch: No batch number. Type it in the "Batch number" box above, then check again.
checks.batchUncertain: The batch number was hard to read. Check it above against your strip, then check again.
checks.priceNotYet: Not available yet: the government ceiling-price list is still being added to DawaCheck.
checks.bannedAlert: This combination of ingredients is prohibited by the Government of India ({notification}). Show this to your pharmacist.
checks.bannedReview: This combination appears in the government's lists of prohibited combinations, with a status a pharmacist should check:
checks.bannedNotListed: Not on the government lists of prohibited combinations that we could match.
checks.bannedNoComposition: We need the ingredients to check this. Add them in the "Ingredients" box above.
checks.legal_stayed: Ban stayed by a High Court
checks.legal_quashed: Ban quashed by a High Court; appeal pending
checks.legal_under_examination: Under examination by an expert committee
checks.noData: Couldn't check: this government list is not loaded into DawaCheck yet.
checks.bannedMaybe: may apply: we could not confirm all its details (the full list of ingredients, the form, release type or strength). Compare with your strip
